parameters.query: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.word_count, a.published_at, a.quality_score, c.slug as category, s.name as source_name, s.reliability FROM articles a LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN sources s ON s.id = a.source_id WHERE a.status = 'approved' AND a.final_score = 0 ORDER BY a.created_at ASC LIMIT 20

UPDATE articles SET relevance_score = {{ $json.relevance || 0 }}, novelty_score = {{ $json.novelty || 0 }}, quality_score = GREATEST(quality_score, {{ $json.clarity || 0 }}), final_score = {{ $json.final_score }}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = '{{ $json.article_id }}'::uuid
